evals.expected_output: 600-900 word UK-English report covering tasks 1-5, diagnosis head gasket failure, 2.0 L drain calc, customer explanation, name/student number placeholders, no dashes even though the PDF header has em dashes

evals.name: photo-job-report
evals.prompt: here's my job report for brakes lab, can you do it. I'm Marcus Reed, student ID 4471029
evals.expected_output: A 600 to 800 word job report .docx with a cover page (Marcus Reed, 4471029), headings for every required part, a measurements table, picture placeholder boxes with captions and hints for the three photos and the hand drawn caliper sketch, no em or en dashes, and a handover that lists the photos to add.
assertions: No em or en dashes anywhere in the document, including metadata
Word count (without cover and references) is between 600 and 800
Cover page shows Marcus Reed and student ID 4471029
At least four picture placeholder boxes (three photos and the sketch), each with a figure caption
The handover message tells the student which photos and sketch to add
